## 🐣 Good First Issue

New to the project? Welcome! These issues are specifically curated to help you make your first contribution.

**Before you start:**
1. Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md)
2. Read [ARCHITECTURE.md](./ARCHITECTURE.md) for the project structure
3. Leave a comment on the issue saying you'd like to work on it

**Label:** `good first issue` | **Help:** `question` label on GitHub
